skill.name: video-edit
skill.description: Routes video edit requests to RunComfy models for restyling, background swaps, packaging changes, motion transfer, and outfit edits. It provides model selection guidance, prompt patterns, and RunComfy CLI invocation examples.
skill.summary: Route video edit tasks to the right RunComfy model with focused prompts and CLI guidance.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, placeholder HTTPS URLs, and example payloads. Confirmed risks are the intended RunComfy CLI execution path, RunComfy account login, local API token storage, and third-party media processing. No prompt injection attempt or hidden malicious instruction was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and package installation are required.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to inspect the RunComfy CLI package source and version before installation, and avoid running commands from untrusted projects.

remediation.issue: Media URLs and prompts are submitted to RunComfy services.
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear consent step before processing private, confidential, or customer-owned media.

remediation.issue: RunComfy login stores an API token in a hidden config path.
remediation.suggestion: Document token rotation, file permission checks, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN environment variable option for CI.

remediation.issue: Example commands use a generic output directory placeholder.
remediation.suggestion: Recommend a project-local output directory and warn users before writing generated files outside the workspace.

content.user_title: Edit Videos with RunComfy Model Routing
content.value_statement: Choosing the wrong video model wastes time and credits. This skill routes each edit request to the best RunComfy model and provides focused prompts.
actual_capabilities: Routes general restyle and background swaps to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video.
Routes motion transfer tasks to Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control.
Routes lightweight outfit and style edits to Lucy Edit Restyle.
Provides model-specific prompt patterns for identity and motion preservation.
Shows RunComfy CLI examples for video, image, audio, and output settings.
Documents model limits for duration, resolution, and route selection.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account and local RunComfy CLI setup.
Sends video, image, and prompt data to RunComfy services.
Each request uses one selected model route only.
Model duration, resolution, and aspect controls vary by route.

use_cases.title: Refresh Product Videos
use_cases.description: Swap backgrounds or packaging while keeping camera motion and hand movement stable.

use_cases.title: Transfer Character Motion
use_cases.description: Map motion from a reference clip onto a target character with identity preservation.

use_cases.title: Restyle Social Clips
use_cases.description: Change outfits, lighting, or scene style while preserving faces and motion.

prompt_templates.title: Simple Restyle
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner edit with one visual change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Edit this video with RunComfy. Preserve the subject face and motion. Change the background to a clean studio setting.

prompt_templates.title: Product Background Swap
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate edit for a product or package clip.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the best RunComfy route for a product video. Keep framing and camera motion. Replace the background with a modern retail display.

prompt_templates.title: Motion Transfer
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced routing when a reference clip controls motion.
prompt_templates.prompt: Route this as a motion control task. Transfer the reference video motion to the target character while preserving character identity.

prompt_templates.title: Identity Stable Commercial Edit
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced edit with preservation, audio, and model constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the correct RunComfy model for this talking-head clip. Preserve face, lip movement, pose, and original audio. Apply warm commercial lighting.

output_examples.input: A user asks to change a talking-head background while keeping the speaker and audio intact.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Wan 2.7 Edit-Video and prepares a preservation-first prompt with original audio retained.

output_examples.input: A user provides a target character and a dance reference clip.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control and frames the request as motion transfer with identity hold.

output_examples.input: A user wants a walking clip to show professional business attire.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Lucy Edit Restyle and focuses the prompt on outfit change while preserving face and motion.

best_practices: Use one edit direction per request to reduce visual drift.
State preservation goals before the requested visual change.
Confirm media URLs are trusted before sending them to RunComfy.
anti_patterns: Do not combine unrelated edits in one model call.
Do not pass private media URLs without user approval.
Do not use motion control when the user only wants a style change.

faq.question: Does this skill edit videos locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the local RunComfy CLI to submit work to RunComfy services.

faq.question: Which models does it route to?
faq.answer: It routes to Wan 2.7 Edit-Video, Kling 2.6 Pro Motion Control, or Lucy Edit Restyle.

faq.question: Can it preserve original audio?
faq.answer: Yes, supported routes include settings for original audio or reference audio preservation.

faq.question: Can it handle private videos?
faq.answer: Use caution. The skill sends media URLs and prompts to RunComfy for processing.

faq.question: Does it choose a model automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. It maps the user intent to the most suitable documented route.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Install the RunComfy CLI, sign in, and provide supported video or image URLs.
